prompt: Help me plan and write an SCI paper on urban effects on extreme precipitation from a current literature review through claim audit.
Build a reproducible literature search with database queries, DOI deduplication, screening reasons and citation chasing.
Read these PDFs including methods, equations, figures and tables and extract claims with page locators.
Turn this hypothesis into an observational and modeling study with controls, validation and sensitivity tests.
Audit spatial cross-validation, temporal leakage, autocorrelation, multiple testing and causal interpretation.
Harmonize ERA5 accumulations, station observations and satellite retrievals across units, UTC and grids.
Review a multi-panel climate map for color scales, significance, area weighting, caption support and accessibility.
Design WRF control and sensitivity ensembles including parameterizations, spin-up, boundaries and budgets.
Estimate heatwave return periods and attribute probability change using factual and counterfactual ensembles.
Audit a CTM and satellite PM2.5 exposure study including emissions, chemistry and health confounding.
Compare ensemble precipitation forecasts by lead time, calibration, CRPS and skill against climatology.
Design validation of a satellite AOD retrieval against AERONET with collocation and representativeness uncertainty.
Draft Methods and Discussion from my real results and verified evidence without inventing missing values.
Check every abstract and conclusion claim against its citation, scope, uncertainty and causal strength.
Produce a prioritized pre-submission peer review with evidence pointers and feasible revision paths.
